title: Residents of Donje Vukovije protest unsafe driving and demand traffic-safety measures
location: Outside the cultural center in Donje Vukovije, Kalesija municipality
organizer: Residents of Donje Vukovije; formal organizer not identified
threshold_50_evidence: The local report confirms an actual peaceful public gathering, but does not give a participant count or other evidence that at least 50 people attended.

start_date.summary: Article dated 8 August 2025 reports that the gathering took place that day.

location.summary: Outside the cultural center in Donje Vukovije.

state_target.summary: Residents demanded more traffic police, speed control infrastructure, clearer signs and faster enforcement; this addresses public traffic-safety policy.

demands.summary: Traffic enforcement and safety infrastructure; mapped provisionally to political behavior/process.

organizer.summary: Residents gathered; local community council president is quoted, but formal organizer is not established.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Gathering occurred, but ≥50 participants is unverified.

notes: A local memorial response to two fatal pedestrian crashes developed into demands for public traffic enforcement and infrastructure; keep the state-policy link separate from the deaths themselves.
open_questions: Did authorities respond to the specific demands?

title: Sarajevo Canton farmers protest delayed agricultural incentive payments; police stop tractor groups
location: Two reported stoppage points: Stup and Semizovac, on approaches to Sarajevo
scope: two farmer convoys heading to the Sarajevo Canton government; organization and simultaneity unresolved
organizer: Agricultural producers from Sarajevo Canton; a farmers association announced the protest
participants_original: Article reports 25 tractors and other farm machines stopped at Stup, and more than 50 tractors stopped near Semizovac; it also says 50–60 tractors had been planned. Human headcount is not reported.
threshold_50_evidence: The article describes two actual tractor convoys stopped by police but provides vehicle counts, not people. No vehicle-to-person conversion is made; simultaneous human attendance of 50+ is unverified.

start_date.summary: Article dated 21 August reports that both convoys were stopped that day.

location.summary: Police stopped one group at Stup and another near Semizovac.

state_target.summary: Farmers sought payment of overdue public agricultural incentives and were heading to the Sarajevo Canton government.

demands.summary: Overdue agricultural support payments; categorized provisionally under farm issues.

organizer.summary: Farmers from multiple Sarajevo Canton municipalities and the FBiH farmers association are identified.

participants_original.summary: 25 tractors/machines at one point and >50 tractors at another; article separately refers to 50–60 planned. No people count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No human count; keep pending threshold.

state_response.summary: Canton police stopped convoys and served a decision prohibiting the assembly.

notes: The planned government-site gathering was prevented at city approaches. Whether stopped convoys constitute one or two continuous public gatherings, and whether ≥50 people assembled together, remains unresolved.
open_questions: How many people were present at either stoppage point?
Did one or both groups form a public gathering after being stopped?
When did each action end, and were the two groups coordinated as one event?
